chunks: And a group of our scholars, may Allah have mercy on them, my father and my brother and others, narrated this hadith from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Abu Sa'id al-Asfuri, from Amr ibn Thabit, Abu al-Miqdam, from his father, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), like it.

And he added in it: 'And the most excellent of stations and dwellings, which Allah causes His friends to dwell in, is Paradise.' My father and my brother and Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) narrated it to me from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ali, who said: 'Abbad Abu Sa'id al-Asfuri narrated to us from Amr ibn Thabit, Abu al-Miqdam, from his father, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), and he mentioned like it with the addition.'

key_terms.الْهُمُومِ: Humility/Lowliness (in the context of the land's character)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Karbala and the Euphrates in Shia theology regarding divine elevation?
ai.summary: This narration, transmitted through a robust chain of Shia scholars including Ibn Qulawayh’s ancestors, emphasizes the spiritual elevation of Karbala and the Euphrates as divine sanctuaries for the righteous. It highlights the contrast between arrogance and humility, promising that those who honor these sites will be granted superior dwellings in Paradise, reinforcing the theological significance of Ziyārah in Shia piety.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 14. My father narrated to me from ‘Ali ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Ali, from Abī Sa’īd ‘Abbād Al-‘Usfuri, from Safwān Al-Jammāl, who said: I heard Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) say: Verily Allāh, the Blessed and the Exalted, has elevated some lands and (bodies of) water above others. Some of these lands and waters boasted to others and some of them transgressed and they have all been punished for not being humble before Allāh. Therefore, Allāh empowered the polytheists over (the land of the) Ka’bah and made the water of Zamzam salty which has ruined its taste. Verily the land of Karbalā and the water of the Euphrates (River) were the first land and (body of) water which glorified Allāh, the Blessed and the Exalted. Therefore, Allāh blessed them and said to the land of Karbalā, “Speak of that with which Allāh, the Exalted, has honoured you, for verily the lands and the waters have boasted to one another.” The land of Karbalā said: I am the sacred and blessed land of Allāh. The (power to) cure has been placed in my dust and in my water, and I am not arrogant. Rather, I am humble and humiliated before He who has blessed me. I do not boast to those who are lower (in rank) than me. Rather, I am thankful to Allāh. Therefore, Allāh honoured it, increased His blessing on it for its humility, and rewarded it with Ḥusain (a.s.) and his companions.
Then Abū ‘Abdillāh (a.s.) added, “Allāh elevates those who humble themselves before Him. And Allāh, the Exalted, degrades those who are arrogant.”
